metadata.description: Fieldwork: an investigative toolkit suite for Claude Code.

plugins.name: magpie
plugins.description: Analyze FOIA releases and data dumps into cited, PII-swept findings, all on your own machine. Part of the Fieldwork suite.

plugins.name: researcher
plugins.description: Research any topic, or a whole batch, into cited, cross-linked notes in your own Obsidian vault. Part of the Fieldwork suite.

plugins.name: librarian
plugins.description: Keeps your Obsidian vault organized: files findings as classified, tagged, wikilinked notes by your conventions, with a full-text index so re-runs update instead of duplicate. Portable Markdown without a vault. Part of the Fieldwork suite.

plugins.name: copydesk
plugins.description: Write your findings up in your own voice, with an AI-pattern review gate and a learning loop that sharpens from your edits. Part of the Fieldwork suite.
